description: This file is a Java source file containing an abstract test class for testing PropertyEditor implementations related to OpenMRS objects. It provides common test logic for setting and retrieving objects by ID or UUID, handling null and invalid inputs, and verifying correct property setting and retrieval.

classes.name: BasePropertyEditorTest
classes.description: An abstract base test class for PropertyEditor implementations in OpenMRS, testing handling of IDs and UUIDs, including null, empty, non-existing, and existing object scenarios.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a new instance of the PropertyEditor under test.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an existing OpenmrsObject for testing.

methods.name: getNonExistingObjectId
methods.description: Returns a non-existing object ID for testing setAsText with invalid ID.

methods.name: getNonExistingObjectUuid
methods.description: Returns a non-existing object UUID for testing setAsText with invalid UUID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the editor before each test by calling getNewEditor.

methods.name: shouldSetTheEditorValueToNullIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that setAsText(null) results in editor value being null.

methods.name: shouldSetTheEditorValueToNullIfGivenAnEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that setAsText("  ") results in editor value being null.

methods.name: shouldSetTheEditorValueToNullIfGivenIdDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that setAsText with a non-existing ID results in null value.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetTheEditorValueIfGivenUuidDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures that setAsText with a non-existing UUID throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: shouldSetTheEditorValueToTheObjectAssociatedWithGivenId
methods.description: Tests that setAsText with a valid ID sets the editor value to the correct object.

methods.name: shouldSetTheEditorValueToObjectAssociatedWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests that setAsText with a valid UUID sets the editor value to the correct object.

methods.name: shouldReturnEmptyStringIfValueIsNull
methods.description: Verifies getAsText returns an empty string when the editor's value is null.

methods.name: shouldReturnTheObjectIdIfValueIsNotNull
methods.description: Checks getAsText returns the object's ID string when the editor's value is set.
